missing_backend_contract.schema_validation: None — only crude string search for 'raw_chain_of_thought' and 'private_reasoning'.
missing_backend_contract.redaction_layer: None — events are stored and transmitted as-is.
missing_backend_contract.secret_scrubbing: None — API keys, tokens, passwords could be in data field.
missing_backend_contract.protected_path_scrubbing: None — paths like memory/semantic could leak via data field.
missing_backend_contract.size_limits: None — large file contents or large strings could bloat trace.ndjson and SSE payload.

risks.title: No redaction layer on backend events
risks.detail: Events are written to trace.ndjson and broadcasted via SSE without any redaction. If a caller includes secrets, protected paths, or raw reasoning in the data field, it will be stored and transmitted.

risks.title: Crude anti-COT check is insufficient
risks.detail: The string search for 'raw_chain_of_thought' in the JSON body can be bypassed by renaming the key or nesting it. It does not prevent chain-of-thought from being included under a different field name or obfuscated encoding.

risks.title: data field is free-form dict
risks.detail: The data field in events accepts any JSON serializable dict. There is no schema, no allowlist, and no redaction for nested fields. This is the primary vector for information leakage.

risks.title: Frontend has no defense-in-depth
risks.detail: agent_trace_console.html renders event data directly into the DOM via innerHTML. If backend is compromised or misconfigured, frontend will display whatever it receives without filtering.

risks.title: No event size limits
risks.detail: Large strings or file contents in the data field could cause memory pressure in SSE queues and frontend rendering slowdown.

VTC_A_ADAPTER_AUDIT.adapter_first_decision: Before patching endpoints or UI, create a dedicated trace_redactor module with explicit rules, then integrate it at the _append_trace_event and _broadcast_trace_event boundaries. This isolates redaction logic from endpoint code and UI code.
